reasons: The final precision directive requires one named observable sigma-field shared by all fixed-query decisions.
The deterministic minimax experiment needs the same explicit rule-before-query convention; its feasible nearest-site witness already satisfies it.

The repaired definition makes \(\mu_s\) explicit and proves that density positivity plus Holder continuity turns the conditional-mean equivalence class into a unique point value, while keeping causal identification separate.
The functional must display the mean label and prove that positivity plus Holder continuity removes conditional-mean version ambiguity at the fixed evaluation point.
Each member must be an explicit labelled point on the common observable sigma-field, with the observed treated mean label and a decision rule that is fixed before the query and parameter point.

The fixed-query experiment needs labelled parameter points on one observable sigma-field so decision rules cannot read potential outcomes or nuisance labels and are selected before Nature chooses the query and parameter point.
The subclass must range over labelled points and state independence under their kernel component, rather than treating a probability law as an element of the repaired labelled class.
The subclass must range over labelled points and impose calendar independence on their observable kernel coordinate after the parent class is corrected.
The open exact-constant handle must inherit the labelled-class and observable-only decision convention after the fixed-query repair.
The narrowed claim requires the fixed-query definitions and the panel class in its dependency and symbol closure.

narrow: The phrase `for every law` suppresses the distinction between a panel regular conditional law, which is defined only marginal-almost-everywhere in the query, and a labelled kernel in the fixed-query class.  The replacement states both valid equalities on their exact domains.
The paired claim correction introduces the labelled kernel coordinate and must carry its complete symbol closure.

narrow: The old statement quantified a bare law as a member of a class whose members must now be labelled points.  The replacement makes the kernel coordinate explicit and excludes every labelling compatible with the shocked observable law.
The paired claim correction names the labels attached to a regular conditional law, so the statement metadata must declare those symbols explicitly.

narrow: A regular conditional law alone is no longer an element of the fixed-query class.  The replacement attaches its observed mean, regression, and covariance labels and retains the essential marginal-almost-everywhere qualifier.
target-estimand-replace: The target metadata must quantify over labelled fixed-query points and preserve the marginal-almost-everywhere panel interpretation.
estimand-functional-replace: The functional metadata must record observed-law uniqueness, the common decision sigma-field, rule-before-query quantification, and the unchanged rough-Holder rates.
target-estimand-replace: The estimand line must quantify over the labelled fixed-query class and record the observable-information restriction without changing the causal object delivered.

estimand-functional-replace: The metadata must reflect the labelled experiment, observed-law uniqueness, common decision-rule information set, rough-Holder scope, and almost-everywhere causal bridge after the class correction.
The honest-length minimax quantifier must range over a single observable-data rule rather than query- or label-specific intervals.
Changing the fixed-query class to labelled points requires the independent-calendar subclass symbol to have the same carrier.
The independent-calendar symbol must inherit the labelled-point type of its parent class.
The prior symbol described an unlabelled set of laws even though the functional and minimax statements require nuisance labels for indexing, not for decision access.
The class symbol currently says its elements are bare laws, which conflicts with the required labelled-point experiment.
The kernel symbol must distinguish the probability-law component from the complete labelled parameter point.
The kernel symbol must distinguish the probability-law coordinate from its labelled parameter point while retaining the notation used for panel regular conditional laws.
The functional symbol must expose its labelled-law argument and its observed-law uniqueness basis.
This makes the decision quantifier common across query values and prevents label-dependent oracle competitors.
The paired claim correction introduces the explicit labelled components, so its declared symbol closure must include the regression and covariance labels.

narrow: Once the fixed-query class consists of labelled parameter points, the old bare-kernel quantifier is ill typed.  The replacement states the same model audit under the observable kernel \(\mathbb K_\xi\), uses the declared mean label \(\mu_s\), and limits panel transfer to the associated labelled point at marginal-almost-every query.

verdict.note: Accept observable labelled-class precision, but reject the artificial no-z0 rule restriction in the fixed-specification experiment and block panel transfer/meta until common treated conditional means across replicas are explicit.
